messages:
Nina C.: Quick update: canary for burst-buffered-coalescer (BBC) just finished at 10% traffic, 4h. TL;DR: p95 down ~14% on mixed chat workloads and token cost down ~9%. No errors surfaced.

perf-bot: ```
BBC CANARY (burst-buffered-coalescer)
workload: mixed-chat (seq avg 420, high burstiness)
baseline: p50=58ms p95=210ms p99=480ms cost=$13.2/1M tokens
canary:   p50=54ms p95=180ms p99=420ms cost=$12.0/1M tokens
delta:    p95 -14% p99 -12.5% cost -9.1%
canary-id: bbc-1955554321
notes: biggest wins during short burst spikes (2-6 reqs in 20ms)
```

Omar V.: Nice. Any unexpected backpressure or queue-depth regressions on the host?

Nina C.: We instrumented host queue_depth and saw median queue depth drop by ~18% during bursts. There was one small increase in serialization latency on a single host in us-west-2 (03:22 UTC) tied to a kernel upgrade roll — infra-watch evicted the host and traffic rebalanced. No user impact.

infra-watch: auto-evict: host i-0abcde removed from pool at 2026-03-21T03:22:47Z due to kernel bug causing io spikes. Replacement completed 38s later.

Omar V.: Good. How about memory footprint when coalescing multiple short requests into larger microbatches?

Nina C.: Peak GPU memory +3% on average; we enforce a per-host microbatch_token_cap of 6000 tokens and fallback to legacy coalescer when mem >80%. Fallback triggered in 0.4% of canary requests.

perf-bot: ```
METRICS SNAPSHOT (sample)
- packed_batch_size: mean=4.1 median=3 p95=9
- microbatch_token_cap: 6000
- pack_success_rate: 99.6%
- fallback_rate: 0.4%
- estimated_cost_reduction: 9.1%
```

Nina C.: Plan: promote to 30% in 24h if no signals. I'll open rollout PR with rollback steps and add histogram of burst inter-arrival times to the dashboard. Filed GH #2190.

Omar V.: Please add an alert for sustained fallback_rate > 2% across any region. Also add region split so we can tune microbatch_token_cap per region.

Nina C.: Will do. Thanks all — ping me if you see anomalies after promotion. :rocket:
